post.description: Every observation must carry data_origin and the provenance that origin requires: REAL_PUBLIC needs source_reference.repository and dataset_accession, SIMULATED needs device_id, DERIVED needs metadata.method. Resending an identical observation_id is counted as a duplicate; reusing an id with different content is rejected.

post.summary: Score standardized feature vectors with a seeded Isolation Forest (experimental, machine learning)
post.description: Server parity path of the browser detector (frontend/web/src/engine/ml), which stays the offline path. Fits PCA whitening and a seeded scikit-learn IsolationForest on the submitted training window (the person's own baseline window of robust z scores), then returns a score, the personal threshold and per feature deviation contributions for each scored vector. Stateless: nothing is stored. Decision support only, never a diagnosis or a status.

post.summary: Daily deviation level of one person against their own baseline (ASTRA, statistical detectors)
post.description: Send the stay of one person so far: one record per day with the daily value of each metric and the mission phase. The person's own PRE_FLIGHT days form the baseline; the expected adaptation and the scale of healthy people come from a reference pack calibrated on NASA bed rest data (an analog, not spaceflight). Returns, per IN_FLIGHT and POST_FLIGHT day, LOW, MODERATE, HIGH or NO_DATA with the detectors that fired. Stateless: nothing is stored. Decision support only, never a diagnosis. Results are DERIVED.

pre_days.title: Pre Days
pre_days.description: Valid PRE_FLIGHT readings found for this metric.

values.title: Values
values.description: Daily value per metric: HEART_RATE bpm, SYSTOLIC_BP and DIASTOLIC_BP mmHg, RESPIRATORY_RATE breaths/min, BODY_TEMPERATURE degC, BODY_WEIGHT kg. A daily mean or a standard morning reading, one value per day.

DayRecord.title: DayRecord
DayRecord.description: One day of one person: the daily value of each metric (null or absent means missing, never zero).

rel_day.title: Rel Day
rel_day.description: Days since the start of IN_FLIGHT (day 1); negative before it. null when there is no IN_FLIGHT day yet.

level.title: Level
level.description: LOW, MODERATE (attention), HIGH (alert) or NO_DATA. Missing data is never LOW.

detectors.title: Detectors
detectors.description: Which detectors fired (confirmed) on this day.

main_indicator.title: Main Indicator
main_indicator.description: Metric with the largest deviation of the day (weight when only its rate fired).

deviation_u.title: Deviation U
deviation_u.description: Deviation of main_indicator in units of normal variation, adaptation already discounted.

deviations.title: Deviations
deviations.description: Standardized deviation u per metric. BODY_WEIGHT is the weight rate of change, not the weight.

multivariate_score.title: Multivariate Score
multivariate_score.description: INFORMATIONAL. Isolation Forest score of the day (0 to 1, higher = more unusual combination of vitals). null when no metric could be evaluated. Never changes level.

multivariate_flag.title: Multivariate Flag
multivariate_flag.description: INFORMATIONAL. True when the score stayed at or above multivariate_threshold on the required consecutive days. Never changes level.

DeviationRequest.title: DeviationRequest
DeviationRequest.description: The whole stay of ONE person so far: PRE_FLIGHT days (baseline), then IN_FLIGHT, then POST_FLIGHT.

invalid_values.title: Invalid Values
invalid_values.description: Values outside the physical plausibility limits, treated as missing.

multivariate_threshold.title: Multivariate Threshold
multivariate_threshold.description: INFORMATIONAL. Score at or above which a day counts for multivariate_flag (99th percentile of simulated healthy days).

assigned_to.title: Assigned To
assigned_to.description: Astronaut id, or null for cabin devices.
